description: This PHP class defines the 'Interview' entity for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, representing interview details such as candidate, interview date/time, name, notes, and interviewers. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: Interview
classes.description: Represents a job interview, including associated candidate, interview date/time, name, notes, and interviewers, and uses doctrine annotations for ORM.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the interview.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the interview.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Retrieves the CandidateVacancy associated with this interview.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Assigns a CandidateVacancy to this interview.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Retrieves the candidate associated with this interview.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a candidate with this interview.

methods.name: getInterviewName
methods.description: Returns the name/title of the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewName
methods.description: Sets the name/title of the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewDate
methods.description: Retrieves the scheduled date of the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewDate
methods.description: Sets the date for the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewTime
methods.description: Retrieves the time of the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewTime
methods.description: Sets the time for the interview.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves notes related to the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of interviewers assigned to this interview.
